note: Diagnostic for task queries and hydration: the TaskNotes candidate prefilter (ee20ca8d) and schema v38's covering indexes for incoming links (9d3d6492), measured together.
binary: cargo build --release -p vulcan-cli at each commit

machine.host: designated evaluation host (Intel Core i7-10700, 31 GiB RAM, Debian 13)

method.timing: wall clock of the whole process; 6 runs, the first discarded; p50 and max of 5. All before runs precede the first after run, which migrates the cache to schema v38 once
method.stage_profile: a temporary instrumented build (not committed) timed tasks query at 100K: lookup 75 ms, Markdown task paths 20 ms, the TaskNotes check of every note 700 ms, hydrating 33K task notes 1.5 s (incoming links 825 ms of it), index extraction 260 ms, task rows 315 ms, evaluation 160 ms

findings: tasks query 'not done' fell from 3,558 to 2,675 ms at 100K and from 333 to 263 ms at 10K with identical output

DQL TABLE file.inlinks fell from 1,830 to 1,459 ms at 100K; at 10K its output changed because incoming links had no defined order and the new index read them in another one. Hydration now sorts each note's incoming links, so the order no longer depends on storage
Migrating the 100K cache to schema v38 took about 1.1 s once
limitations: The two changes are measured together
Host power, frequency, background load, and OS page cache are uncontrolled
